title: Data Looker
description: Easily look at data from entities, blocks, storage, and scoreboards
body:
I was building a datapack when I got tired of fishing through the results of `/data get`. *Instead,* using `/data look` formats your query in a screen which you can scroll through or copy from. Using the `M` key will reopen the last looker screen to save you from selecting the entity again.

|![data get command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59bc24d982b1b6a5483494864eba252645750237.png)|![data look command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0079fbf632cb08ac5614e0131ed7d46789f272ca.png)|
|---------|--------|
|![data get result](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ooyszcLB/images/e38eb880e6064e66cbf2ca27e4f9961ce12d0fcc.png)|![data look result](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ooyszcLB/images/e854f118e0045e5ecc749d9fe2b368289584acb2.png)|

Clicking on the `name:` of a **{object}** or **[list]** will collapse it and right clicking any entry will copy it's path to the clipboard.

|Theres more kinds of data... | Look at Scoreboards too!  |
